title: Business Process Model
description: Visual model of the Business Processes Catalogue (BUS-PRO), arranged as a nested card diagram: Level 1 processes as groups, Level 2 processes as items within each group, and Level 3 processes nested within each Level 2 item. The overview renders Levels 1-2 on one diagram; a drill-down diagram per Level 1 process follows, showing its Level 2 cards with their Level 3 processes inside. Derived from BUS-PRO rather than authored directly.

meta.description: A visual map of the organisation's key processes, arranged as a nested hierarchy.
purpose: Give a single-page view of the process landscape for workshops and roadmap discussions.
Reveal the decomposition from process groups down to individual process steps.
Drill into each Level 1 process to see its Level 2 and Level 3 breakdown.
Provide an embeddable diagram for presentations, kept in sync with BUS-PRO.
